title: PSG's top league scorers since 2000
brief: Name the ten players with the most Ligue 1 goals for PSG from 2000/01 to 2025/26.

notes.Javier Pastore: Pastore is 11th with 29 goals, just outside.
notes.Bradley Barcola: Barcola is 11th equal with 29 goals, just outside.

checks: Summed from Transfermarkt PSG season pages 2000/01 to 2025/26. Each name checked against the Transfermarkt match log (exact) and the season-by-season Wikipedia career table (exact except Hoarau 2010/11: Wikipedia 9, Transfermarkt 10, so 38 or 39; either way 7th). Moura and Dembele are level on 34 for the last two places; Pastore and Barcola have 29.
